name: Ort Furniture Manufacturing Co
old_description: Experience the Ort difference: handcrafted, American-made furniture built with hardwood frames, Amish craftsmanship, and backed by a lifetime limited warranty for lasting comfort.
about:
Ort Furniture Manufacturing Co has operated from Salem, Ohio since its founding in 1957. The company began as a recliner manufacturer and has expanded to produce a full line of upholstered furniture for residential use.

The company handcrafts furniture using solid hardwood frames built by Amish craftsmen, paired with sustainably sourced wood and strengthened steel hardware. Its product range includes more than 70 recliner styles—electric power, oversized, mission, wall-hugger, swivel rocker—as well as sofas, love seats, chairs, modular seating, and occasional pieces. Customers can choose from over 360 premium fabric and leather options for customization.

Ort Furniture sells primarily through retail furniture stores across the Midwest, supplying independent dealers with its American-made upholstered lines. The company also operates a direct-to-consumer showroom and e-commerce channel, offering free shipping on all orders with no minimum purchase.

The business emphasizes durability and comfort, backing every piece with a lifetime limited warranty. Its differentiation rests on Amish construction techniques, domestic manufacturing, and a broad customization program that allows retailers to tailor pieces to regional tastes.
